name: perch
description: Claude Code and Codex agents as tabs in one sidebar, each with its own look, plus Claude usage and backend switching. A shell, not an agent.

commands.title: Perch: Hand Off Last Answer to Another Tab…

perch.claude.permissionMode.description: Claude Code permission mode for new tabs. bypassPermissions skips all prompts.

perch.claude.model.description: Claude model for new tabs, for example opus, sonnet, or a full model id. Empty uses Claude Code's default. Each tab can change it live.

perch.claude.effort.description: Claude reasoning effort for new tabs, for example high. Empty uses the model's default. Ignored if the tab's model does not accept it. Each tab can change it live.

perch.claude.executable.description: Path to a claude CLI to use instead of the one bundled with the Agent SDK.

perch.codex.approvalPolicy.description: Codex approval policy. The Codex SDK runs non-interactively, so approvals resolve by policy, not by prompt.

perch.codex.sandboxMode.description: Codex sandbox mode for new tabs.

perch.codex.model.description: Codex model for new tabs, for example gpt-6-sol. Empty uses the model in ~/.codex/config.toml. Set per tab before its first message.

perch.codex.reasoningEffort.description: Codex reasoning effort for new tabs, for example high. Empty uses ~/.codex/config.toml or the model's default. Ignored if the tab's model does not accept it.

enumDescriptions: Cost when Claude is configured for Bedrock or API, subscription limits otherwise.
Subscription limits from the usage endpoint.
Token totals and estimated cost from local transcripts.
perch.meter.mode.description: What the Claude usage gauge shows.

perch.meter.pollMinutes.description: How often the Claude usage gauge refreshes, in minutes.

perch.meter.display.description: Show percent remaining, fuel-tank style, or percent used.

perch.meter.showModelWeekly.description: Also show model-scoped weekly limits when reported.

perch.meter.warnBelow.description: Warning colour when any limit has less than this percent remaining.

perch.meter.errorBelow.description: Error colour when any limit has less than this percent remaining.

perch.meter.hideWhenUnavailable.description: Hide the status bar items when no Claude credentials are found.

enumDescriptions: Show the status bar items unless the standalone AI Meter extension is installed.
Never show them; the panel footer is enough.
perch.meter.statusBar.description: Whether Perch puts the Claude usage gauge and backend switch in the status bar.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js test/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:offline: node test/meter.test.js && node test/codexMeter.test.js && node test/models.test.js && node test/host.test.js && node test/page.test.js
